questions.q: What is the best angle for a solar panel to maximize solar gain in a tropical country like the Philippines?
questions.n: Orienting panels at 30 degrees facing South is a standard recommendation to optimize solar exposure based on the sun's path.

questions.q: Which type of glass is specifically designed for superior acoustics and non-transmission of noise?
questions.n: Double glazing (Insulated Glass Units) uses an air or gas space between two panes to significantly reduce sound transmission.

questions.q: Who is the architect credited with the first use of a complete steel frame in a building, specifically for the Home Insurance Building?
questions.n: Jenney is hailed as the 'Father of the American Skyscraper' for designing the first fully steel-framed building.

questions.q: Which characteristic is most defining of Egyptian Architecture?
questions.n: Egyptian architecture is known for its massive columns and the use of lintels (trabeated system) rather than arches.

questions.q: Which pump should be used to move water that has flooded a basement up to the ground floor for disposal?
questions.n: A transfer pump is designed to move water from one location (like a flooded basement) to another (like the ground level drainage).

questions.q: Which Greek architect is famous for his work as an urban planner and the theory of Ekistics?
questions.n: Constantinos Apostolou Doxiadis was a Greek architect-planner who founded the science of Ekistics (human settlements).

questions.q: What is the standard compressive strength (psi) for a LOAD-BEARING Concrete Hollow Block (CHB)?
questions.n: Under local standards (ASTM C90), load-bearing blocks must reach a minimum of 750 to 800 psi.

questions.q: What is the standard compressive strength (psi) for a NON LOAD-BEARING CHB?
questions.n: Non-load bearing blocks are typically rated at a minimum of 400 psi (approx 2.8 MPa).

questions.q: A type of ceiling where a portion of it is lowered to form a layer or hide services is called a:
questions.n: A dropped (or suspended) ceiling creates a second layer below the main structure.

questions.q: Which light color temperature is best suited for 'Task Lighting' to improve focus and clarity?
questions.n: Cool white (4000K-5000K) provides better contrast and reduces eye strain for reading or detailed work.

questions.q: Who was the first registered woman architect in the Philippines?
questions.n: Mercedes Raffiñan holds the distinction of being the first female registered architect in the country.

questions.q: According to the National Structural Code, what is the standard Live Load (kg/sqm) for Residential Floors?
questions.n: The standard live load for general residential occupancy is 200 kg/sqm (approx 1.9 kPa).

questions.q: What material can be placed as insulation inside the voids of a drywall system to improve sound and thermal properties?
questions.n: Spray foam or rigid foam boards are commonly used as void fillers for insulation in drywalls.

questions.q: What is the most effective and professional method for drying wood to achieve specific moisture content?
questions.n: Kiln drying uses controlled heat and airflow to dry lumber quickly and uniformly to a desired moisture content.

questions.q: What is the maximum flush volume (liters) allowed for a DUAL FLUSH water closet?
questions.n: The maximum full flush for a standard dual-flush toilet is 6 liters.

questions.q: What is the maximum flush volume (liters) for a modern SINGLE FLUSH water closet under efficiency standards?
questions.n: High-efficiency toilets (HET) are often rated at 4.9 liters (1.3 gallons) per flush.

questions.q: What is the standard maximum liters per flush for a urinal?
questions.n: The standard maximum for a modern high-efficiency urinal is 1 liter per flush.

questions.q: For a 4-meter span beam, what is the recommended camber height to prevent sagging?
questions.n: A common rule of thumb for small spans is approximately 1/1000 or slightly more; 4.5mm is a cited standard for a 4m span.

questions.q: What is the standard spacing (horizontal and vertical) for CHB wall reinforcement?
questions.n: Reinforcing bars in standard CHB walls are typically spaced at 600mm (0.60m) both ways.

questions.q: What is the minimum glass thickness (mm) for a shower enclosure door?
questions.n: 8mm is widely accepted as the safe minimum thickness for tempered glass shower doors.

questions.q: What is the typical slope for a pressurized water supply pipe?
questions.n: Pressurized water supply pipes do not require a slope because the water moves via pressure, not gravity.

questions.q: Why is a pivot door often avoided as the main entrance for high-traffic commercial buildings?
o: It cannot be made of glass
It is too heavy to push
It requires large space for the frame and swing
questions.n: Pivot doors require significant clearance for their sweep and bulky frame hardware, which can obstruct commercial flow.

questions.q: Which brand is the most famous supplier of high-quality electrical wires in the Philippines?
questions.n: Phelps Dodge is the leading and most recognized brand for building wires and cables in the local market.

questions.q: What is the standard commercial length (meters) of an angle bar?
questions.n: The standard commercial length for most structural steel sections like angle bars and pipes is 6.0 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum thickness (mm) of a concrete slab required to achieve a 2-hour fire rating?
questions.n: A 125mm (5-inch) thick concrete slab is the standard minimum for a 2-hour fire-resistance rating.

questions.q: What is the minimum size (sqm) of a vent shaft for toilets according to the National Building Code?
questions.n: The National Building Code (Rule VIII) specifies a minimum area of 1.00 square meter for a ventilation shaft.
